Custody, all twenty recorded inputs, live HEAD/file-08/required-now pins, the DR-G09 OPEN token, frozen-v3 treatment, the exact unchanged seven-obligation bit vector, the sole OBL-FX-AUTHORING remainder, fourteen-FX versus R-10/R-6 separation, and every no-SATISFIED/no-byte/no-implementation boundary pass.
